handoff.description: Where the work should resume if it is picked up later: what remains, which files are half-done, and what to do first. The finishing step includes it in maintenance/dream-report.md; a later run may read that report, but no handoff message is delivered automatically. If the run completed everything planned, say so explicitly ("nothing left; memory is tidy"). One short paragraph — the report carries the detail.

status.description: "done" when the planned work is complete; "handoff" when the whole run is stopping early (budget, time, or a task that needs the user). Defaults to "done". Do not call DreamDone at the end of a single tier's turn: the harness starts the next tier automatically and this call ends the run. This word is for your own bookkeeping — the harness decides the run's terminal status.
